# API regression fixture notices

These notices apply to the regression input fixtures in `inputs/`. They do not
change the Apache-2.0 license of affine-bundle-solver and do not imply that the
upstream authors endorse this project.

## Generated abs-apps cases (`T8-001` through `T8-029`)

The arrays were generated by `metronforge/abs-apps` at commit
`ae9b662d7f5755418aa80f31ade1fffcbefebafd`, using
`campaigns/affine-bundle-solver-1000/results/task8-targeted-expansion/task8_cases.py`.
The individual construction parameters and source paths are retained in
`manifest.json`.

## Radio Astronomy Software Group (`T8-030` through `T8-032`)

These arrays are derived from the PAPER observation
`zen.2456865.60537.xy.uvcRREAAM.uvfits` in the Radio Astronomy Software Group
`rasg-datasets` repository at revision
`55bd68b28fabe0936011bd9540cbaef9e20809db`. The retained source artifact has
SHA-256 `2544212e4bba85319c4628b1e019aa79b6e988a310cd258b258165a3999439e9`.
The transformation uses three channels and the fixed realified small-field
Fourier operator described in the manifest.

## SuiteSparse Matrix Collection (`T8-036` through `T8-039`)

The matrix values derive from the following SuiteSparse Matrix Collection
objects. Each fixture converts the complete symmetric sparse matrix to dense
binary64 and uses the controlled right-hand side `b = e0`; the right-hand side
is not measured source data.

| Fixture | Object | Matrix author | Matrix editors |
|---|---|---|---|
| `T8-036` | `HB/bcsstk01` | J. Lewis | I. Duff, R. Grimes, J. Lewis |
| `T8-037` | `HB/bcsstk02` | J. Lewis | I. Duff, R. Grimes, J. Lewis |
| `T8-038` | `HB/bcsstk04` | J. Lewis | I. Duff, R. Grimes, J. Lewis |
| `T8-039` | `HB/bcsstk05` | J. Lewis | I. Duff, R. Grimes, J. Lewis |

The collection identifies its data license as Creative Commons Attribution
4.0 International (CC BY 4.0): <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/>.
Collection information and access: <https://sparse.tamu.edu/about>.

Please cite:

- Timothy A. Davis and Yifan Hu, “The University of Florida Sparse Matrix
  Collection,” ACM Transactions on Mathematical Software 38(1), 2011,
  DOI: <https://doi.org/10.1145/2049662.2049663>.
- Scott P. Kolodziej, Mohsen Aznaveh, Matthew Bullock, Jarrett David,
  Timothy A. Davis, Matthew Henderson, Yifan Hu, and Read Sandstrom,
  “The SuiteSparse Matrix Collection Website Interface,” Journal of Open
  Source Software 4(35), 1244, 2019,
  DOI: <https://doi.org/10.21105/joss.01244>.
